subject: general
question: Which of the following states has the largest tribal population as per Census 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Madhya Pradesh** has the largest tribal population in India as per Census 2011.
 
• Tribal population in Madhya Pradesh is approximately **21.1%** of the state's total population.
